vulnerability.explanation: pkey is used without a NULL check after load_keyparams(). If loading the DSA parameters fails (e.g., invalid or missing dsaparam-file), load_keyparams() can return NULL. The subsequent call to EVP_PKEY_get_bits(pkey) dereferences a NULL pointer, leading to a crash. This is a concrete path: provide an invalid params file so load_keyparams() returns NULL, bio_open_owner() succeeds, then line 138 dereferences NULL. Subsequent uses (e.g., lines 139–145) also assume pkey is non-NULL.
